slots.name: prerelease access window
slots.sentence: U.S. Executive Order 14409, titled “ Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security ,” was signed on June 2, 2026, and establishes a classified process for designating “covered frontier models” and a voluntary framework under which developers grant the federal government up to 30 days of prerelease access, while expressly disclaiming any mandatory licensing, preclearance, or permitting regime.
